text: 法国总统候选人、极右翼政党国民联盟领导人玛丽娜·勒庞提出一项雄心勃勃的新财政计划，目标是到2032年将法国财政赤字占国内生产总值(GDP)的比重降至3%以下，计划从2027年起将法国赤字降至5%以下。勒庞周二公布了国民联盟为明年制定的预算方案，这一方案将在她赢得即将举行的法国总统选举的情况下实施。随着对法国政治前景和债务不断膨胀的担忧引发债券市场动荡，她正寻求安抚投资者。
text_en: French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen, leader of the far-right National Rally party, proposed an ambitious new fiscal plan aimed at reducing France's fiscal deficit to below 3% of gross domestic product (GDP) by 2032, with a plan to bring the French deficit below 5% starting in 2027. Le Pen unveiled the National Rally's budget proposal for next year on Tuesday, which would be implemented if she wins the upcoming French presidential election. She is seeking to reassure investors as concerns about France's political outlook and ballooning debt trigger bond market turmoil.
